definitions.ask: Should the album and the spine keep a "Why I use SASE" section?
definitions.why: Every version of the ^section-field outline omits it; adding it later is one YAML line

choices.label: Leave it out, matching ^section-field; the spine drops its "Why I use SASE" stub
Add `why: 🙋 Why I use SASE` after `intro`; the spine keeps that stub as section 1

definitions.ask: Should the album and the spine keep a separate Conclusion after Future Work?

choices.label: Future Work closes the post; the spine drops its "Conclusion" stub
Add `close: 🏁 Conclusion` after `future`; the spine keeps that stub last
